Definition: neuter of comparative of ἧκα (slightly) used for that of G2556; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.
BiblicalUsage: Hḗtton means worse, or less. It turns up twice, in 1 Corinthians and 2 Corinthians — once for coming together “for the worse”, once for being loved “the less”.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hḗtton as it stands — worse, less — and I read the passages with that plain sense in mind.
